# Granny Flat Permit

> Granny Flat Permit (part of GetMyPermit) handles building permit applications for granny flats (ancillary dwellings) in Perth and Western Australia, including checking the R-Codes exemption for granny flats up to 70 square metres.

## Pages

- [Granny flat permits in WA, done for you.](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/): Need a granny flat building permit in Perth or WA? We check the 70 m² rules for your lot, prepare the plans and lodge your application. Fixed price.
- [Granny flat rules in WA](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-rules-wa): The granny flat rules in WA in plain English: the 70 m² limit, no minimum lot size, setbacks, parking, renting it out, and when planning approval is still needed.
- [The granny flat approval process in WA](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-approval-process): How to get a granny flat approved in WA, step by step: checking your lot, fitting the 70 m² rules, planning approval if needed, and the building permit.
- [Granny flats on rural lots in WA](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-on-a-rural-lot): Building a granny flat on a rural or farming lot in WA? Why the 2024 exemption often doesn't apply, what shires look at, and how we handle the approvals.
- [Transportable vs built-on-site granny flat](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/transportable-vs-built-granny-flat): Transportable vs built-on-site granny flats in WA: the approvals are the same, plus the real differences in payments, delivery and builder responsibility.
- [How to choose a granny flat builder in Perth](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/choosing-a-granny-flat-builder): How to choose a granny flat builder in Perth: check registration, the written contract, the 6.5% deposit limit, home indemnity insurance, approvals and the 6-year defect period.
- [City of Joondalup granny flat rules](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/city-of-joondalup-granny-flat-rules): City of Joondalup granny flat rules: when you skip planning approval, the 70 m² limit, the extra car bay rule, matching design, structure plan areas and building permits.
- [Can I subdivide my granny flat later?](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/subdivide-granny-flat): Can you subdivide or strata title a granny flat in WA? Why the R-Codes don't allow it, the only way to split it off, and what to think about before you build.
- [Granny flat 70 m² calculator](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-size-calculator): Free calculator: add up your granny flat's rooms and check the 70 m² internal floor area limit in WA, with how to measure and what happens if you go over.
- [Is there a minimum lot size for a granny flat?](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-minimum-lot-size): No. WA removed the 350 m² minimum lot size for granny flats in April 2024. What now decides if a granny flat fits: setbacks, open space, height, privacy and access.
- [Granny flat cost in Perth (2026)](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-cost-perth): Granny flats in Perth start from about $119,000 to $196,000 in 2026, before site works and finishes. Builder prices compared and worked examples of the council fees and levies.
- [Granny flat vs tiny home](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-vs-tiny-home): In WA a tiny home on footings is legally a granny flat; on wheels it is a caravan. Approvals, how long you can live in each, renting and costs compared.
- [How to design a granny flat that needs no planning approval](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/granny-flat-no-planning-approval): A WA granny flat of 70 m² or less that meets the standard R-Codes rules needs no planning approval. A seven-point design checklist, the exceptions and how to check your lot.
- [Guides](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to granny flats approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://grannyflatpermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for granny flats in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Granny flat, your builder's plans from $2,950.
